startups.name: EventRadar AI
startups.problem: Students miss hackathons, tech events, and startup opportunities because discovery is scattered across WhatsApp groups, LinkedIn, Luma, college clubs, and random websites.
startups.target_users: College students, student founders, and early-stage builders.
startups.solution: AI-powered event discovery that ranks opportunities based on skills, goals, location, and deadline urgency.
startups.why_ai: The app does not just list events. It matches events to a student's profile and explains why each event is worth attending.
startups.competitors: Luma, LinkedIn Events, WhatsApp groups, college club pages.
startups.traction: Prototype built with scraped event data and ranking logic.
